sub_sector.value: industrial and performance coatings; architectural paints; specialty materials

manufacturing_type.detail: Formulates and manufactures paints, stains, protective coatings, sealants, and specialty materials.

product_complexity.detail: Develops high-performance coatings, aircraft transparencies and sealants, and advanced materials for optical and display applications.

production_role.detail: Produces coatings and specialty materials, supplies vehicle coatings directly to automakers, and sells finished branded paints and stains.

end_market_exposure.detail: Industrial manufacturing, automotive and marine, buildings and infrastructure, aircraft, consumer packaging, oil and gas, power and renewables, and OLED displays.

notes: The balance between made-to-order and stocked production is unclear.
